name: What's the difference between sheet fall and boulder waterfall?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between sheet fall and boulder waterfall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sheet falls use stainless steel weirs for glassy precision; boulder falls stack natural stone for organic cascading—sheet for modern, boulder for natural aesthetics.
